en.R: These are the brave things Benaiah son of Jehoiada did. He became as famous as the three best warriors.

es.L: Estas [cosas] hizo Benaía hijo de Joiada, y tuvo nombre entre los tres valientes.
es.B: Tales fueron las hazañas de Benaía hijo de Joiada, y se ganó un nombre junto a los tres guerreros valientes.
es.R: Estas son las cosas valientes que hizo Benaía hijo de Joiada. Llegó a ser tan famoso como los tres mejores guerreros.

fr.L: Voilà ce que fit Benaya, fils de Yehoyada, et il eut un nom parmi les trois vaillants hommes.
fr.B: Tels furent les exploits de Benaya, fils de Yehoyada, et il se fit un nom à côté des trois vaillants guerriers.
fr.R: Voilà les actes courageux de Benaya, fils de Yehoyada. Il est devenu aussi célèbre que les trois meilleurs guerriers.

sw.L: Mambo haya aliyafanya Benaya mwana wa Yehoyada, naye alikuwa na jina miongoni mwa wale mashujaa watatu.
sw.B: Hayo ndiyo matendo ya Benaya mwana wa Yehoyada, naye akapata jina pamoja na wale mashujaa watatu.
sw.R: Hayo ndiyo mambo ya ujasiri aliyoyafanya Benaya mwana wa Yehoyada. Akawa maarufu kama wale wapiganaji watatu hodari kuliko wote.

vi.L: Đó [là những việc] Bê-na-gia con trai Giê-hô-gia-đa đã làm, và ông nổi danh trong ba dũng sĩ.
vi.B: Đó là những chiến công của Bê-na-gia con trai Giê-hô-gia-đa, và ông nổi danh ngang với ba dũng sĩ.
vi.R: Đó là những việc can đảm Bê-na-gia con trai Giê-hô-gia-đa đã làm. Ông nổi tiếng như ba chiến binh giỏi nhất.

ko.L: 여호야다의 아들 브나야가 이런 일들을 하여 세 용사 가운데서 이름을 얻었다.
ko.B: 여호야다의 아들 브나야가 한 일은 이러했다. 그는 세 용사와 나란히 이름을 떨쳤다.
ko.R: 여호야다의 아들 브나야가 한 용감한 일은 이러했다. 그는 세 용사만큼 유명해졌다.

pt.L: Estas [coisas] fez Benaia, filho de Joiada, e teve nome entre os três valentes.
pt.B: Esses foram os feitos de Benaia, filho de Joiada, e ele ganhou fama ao lado dos três guerreiros.
pt.R: Essas são as coisas corajosas que Benaia, filho de Joiada, fez. Ele ficou tão famoso quanto os três melhores guerreiros.

am.L: የዮዳሄ ልጅ በናያስ እነዚህን [ነገሮች] አደረገ፤ በሦስቱም ኃያላን መካከል ስም ነበረው።
am.B: የዮዳሄ ልጅ በናያስ ያደረጋቸው ሥራዎች እንዲህ ያሉ ነበሩ፤ ከሦስቱ ጀግኖች ጋርም ስም አተረፈ።
am.R: የዮዳሄ ልጅ በናያስ ያደረጋቸው የጀግንነት ሥራዎች እነዚህ ናቸው። እንደ ሦስቱ ምርጥ ተዋጊዎች ዝነኛ ሆነ።

hi.L: ये [काम] यहोयादा के पुत्र बनायाह ने किए, और उन तीन वीर योद्धाओं के बीच उसका नाम [था]।
hi.B: यहोयादा के पुत्र बनायाह के काम ऐसे थे, और उसने तीनों वीर योद्धाओं के बराबर नाम कमाया।
hi.R: ये यहोयादा के पुत्र बनायाह के साहस के काम हैं। वह तीनों सबसे अच्छे योद्धाओं के बराबर प्रसिद्ध हो गया।

ru.L: Это сделал Ванея, сын Иодая, и он имел имя среди трёх воинов-богатырей.
ru.B: Таковы были подвиги Ванеи, сына Иодая, и он прославился наравне с тремя воинами-богатырями.
ru.R: Вот какие подвиги совершил Ванея, сын Иодая. Он стал так же знаменит, как трое самых храбрых воинов.

ja.L: ヨヤダの子ベナヤは、これらのことを行い、三人の勇士の中で名を得た。
ja.B: ヨヤダの子ベナヤの働きは、このようなものであった。彼は三勇士と並んで名を上げた。
ja.R: ヨヤダの息子ベナヤは、このような勇敢なことをしました。ベナヤは、三人の勇士と同じくらい有名になりました。

uk.L: Це зробив Беная, син Єгояди, і він мав імʼя серед трьох хоробрих.
uk.B: Ось такі подвиги вчинив Беная, син Єгояди, і він здобув собі імʼя поряд з трьома хоробрими воїнами.
uk.R: Ось такі відважні вчинки зробив Беная, син Єгояди. Він став таким же славним, як троє найкращих воїнів.

decisions.choice: a name among the three mighty men: fame equal to theirs, though not one of them
decisions.reason: "Among" here means "alongside" or "as well as", since verse 23 says he did not reach the Three. The wording matches what is said of Abishai in verse 18.

source.text: מִן־הַשְּׁלֹשִׁ֣ים נִכְבָּ֔ד וְאֶל־הַשְּׁלֹשָׁ֖ה לֹא־בָ֑א וַיְשִׂמֵ֥הוּ דָוִ֖ד אֶל־מִשְׁמַעְתּֽוֹ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Than the thirty honored, and to the three not he came; and set him David over his bodyguard.

en.L: Above the Thirty he was honored, but to the Three he did not come; and David set him over his bodyguard.
en.B: He was honored above the Thirty, but he did not reach the rank of the Three. And David put him in charge of his bodyguard.
en.R: He was honored more than the Thirty, but he was never one of the Three. David made him the leader of his own guards.

es.L: Fue más honrado que los Treinta, pero a los Tres no llegó; y David lo puso sobre su guardia personal.
es.B: Fue honrado más que los Treinta, pero no alcanzó el rango de los Tres. Y David lo puso al mando de su guardia personal.
es.R: Fue más honrado que los Treinta, pero nunca fue uno de los Tres. David lo nombró jefe de su propia guardia.

fr.L: Plus que les Trente il fut honoré, mais jusqu’aux Trois il n’arriva pas ; et David le mit à la tête de sa garde personnelle.
fr.B: Il fut plus honoré que les Trente, mais il n’atteignit pas le rang des Trois. Et David lui confia le commandement de sa garde personnelle.
fr.R: Il était plus honoré que les Trente, mais il n’a jamais fait partie des Trois. David a fait de lui le chef de ses propres gardes.

sw.L: Aliheshimiwa kuliko wale Thelathini, lakini hakufikia wale Watatu; naye Daudi akamweka juu ya walinzi wake.
sw.B: Aliheshimiwa kuliko wale Thelathini, lakini hakufikia cheo cha wale Watatu. Naye Daudi akamweka kuwa mkuu wa walinzi wake.
sw.R: Aliheshimiwa kuliko wale Thelathini, lakini hakuwa kamwe mmoja wa wale Watatu. Daudi akamfanya kuwa kiongozi wa walinzi wake mwenyewe.

vi.L: Ông được tôn trọng hơn nhóm Ba Mươi, nhưng không đạt tới nhóm Ba; và Đa-vít lập ông chỉ huy đội cận vệ của mình.
vi.B: Ông được tôn trọng hơn nhóm Ba Mươi, nhưng không được kể vào hàng nhóm Ba. Đa-vít lập ông chỉ huy đội cận vệ của mình.
vi.R: Ông được tôn trọng hơn nhóm Ba Mươi, nhưng không bao giờ thuộc về nhóm Ba. Đa-vít cho ông làm người chỉ huy đội cận vệ của vua.

ko.L: 그는 삼십 인보다 존경을 받았으나, 세 용사에는 이르지 못했다. 다윗이 그를 자기 경호대 위에 세웠다.
ko.B: 그는 삼십 인보다 더 존경을 받았으나, 세 용사의 반열에는 들지 못했다. 다윗은 그에게 자기 경호대를 맡겼다.
ko.R: 그는 삼십 용사보다 더 존경을 받았지만, 세 용사 가운데 하나가 되지는 못했다. 다윗은 그를 자기 경호대의 대장으로 삼았다.

pt.L: Acima dos Trinta foi honrado, mas aos Três não chegou; e Davi o pôs sobre a sua guarda.
pt.B: Ele foi mais honrado do que os Trinta, mas não chegou à posição dos Três. E Davi o colocou no comando da sua guarda pessoal.
pt.R: Ele foi mais honrado do que os Trinta, mas nunca foi um dos Três. Davi o fez chefe da sua própria guarda.

am.L: ከሠላሳዎቹ ይልቅ የከበረ ነበረ፤ ወደ ሦስቱ ግን አልደረሰም፤ ዳዊትም በጠባቂዎቹ ላይ ሾመው።
am.B: ከሠላሳዎቹ በላይ የከበረ ነበረ፤ ነገር ግን የሦስቱን ማዕረግ አልደረሰም። ዳዊትም የግል ጠባቂዎቹ አለቃ አደረገው።
am.R: ከሠላሳዎቹ የበለጠ ክብር አገኘ፤ ነገር ግን ከሦስቱ አንዱ ሆኖ አያውቅም። ዳዊትም የገዛ ጠባቂዎቹ መሪ አደረገው።

hi.L: वह तीसों से अधिक आदरणीय [था], पर वह तीनों तक नहीं पहुँचा; और दाऊद ने उसे अपने अंगरक्षकों पर ठहराया।
hi.B: वह तीसों से अधिक आदर पाता था, पर वह तीनों के पद तक नहीं पहुँचा। दाऊद ने उसे अपने अंगरक्षकों का अधिकारी बनाया।
hi.R: उसे तीसों से अधिक आदर मिला, पर वह कभी तीनों में से एक नहीं हुआ। दाऊद ने उसे अपने पहरेदारों का अगुवा बनाया।

ru.L: Больше Тридцати он был почитаем, но до Троих он не дошёл; и поставил его Давид над своей охраной.
ru.B: Его почитали больше Тридцати, но он не достиг степени Троих. Давид поставил его во главе своей личной охраны.
ru.R: Его почитали больше, чем Тридцать, но он никогда не был одним из Троих. Давид сделал его начальником своих телохранителей.

ja.L: 彼は三十人よりも重んじられたが、三人には及ばなかった。そしてダビデは彼を自分の護衛の上に立てた。
ja.B: 彼は三十人よりも重んじられたが、三勇士の位には達しなかった。ダビデは彼を、自分の護衛隊の長にした。
ja.R: ベナヤは、三十人の勇士よりも重んじられましたが、三人の勇士の一人ではありませんでした。ダビデはベナヤを、自分を守る護衛の兵士たちの隊長にしました。

uk.L: Над Тридцятьма він був шанований, але до Трьох не дійшов; і поставив його Давид над своєю охороною.
uk.B: Його шанували більше за Тридцятьох, але він не дорівнявся Трьом. І Давид поставив його над своєю охороною.
uk.R: Його шанували більше за Тридцятьох, але він ніколи не був одним з Трьох. Давид зробив його начальником своєї власної охорони.

decisions.choice: over his bodyguard: in command of the men who guarded the king
decisions.reason: The word comes from the verb "to hear" and means those who listen and obey, here the king's personal guard (1 Samuel 22:14). This fits Benaiah's command of the Cherethites and the Pelethites (8:18; 20:23).

decisions.choice: honored above the Thirty, not reaching the Three: as Abishai in verse 19
decisions.reason: Benaiah, like Abishai, stood between the two groups. 1 Chronicles 11:25 says the same.

decisions.choice: Asahel among the Thirty: the list names men from the whole of David's reign
decisions.reason: Asahel was killed by Abner early in David's reign at Hebron (2:18-23), so the list is a roll of honor that includes men who fell, and not a roster from one moment.

decisions.choice: the list of the Thirty: 1 Chronicles 11:26-41
decisions.reason: From here the list matches 1 Chronicles 11:26-41, which spells many names differently or has other names. The notes on each verse name the main differences. Elhanan son of Dodo is not the Elhanan of 21:19.

decisions.choice: names as given in the Hebrew, with commas between the entries
decisions.reason: Every name is spelled as the Hebrew text has it in Samuel, even where Chronicles differs. The list runs on as one sentence to verse 39.

decisions.choice: the list runs through verses 24-39 as one sentence, each verse holding its own names, and closes in verse 39
decisions.reason: Korean lists names in the Hebrew order without trouble; only the closing verb has to wait for verse 39, which already has "thirty-seven in all".

decisions.choice: One formula for the list (23:24-39): the clan or town word comes first with the article, then the name ("ሐሮዳዊው ሣማ", "ቴቁሐዊው የዒቃሽ ልጅ ዒራ"), entries separated by "፣", and the verb only at the end ("... ነበሩ", 23:39); Readable writes "ከ... የሆነው" where the English Readable says "from"
decisions.reason: Amharic puts a describing word before the noun it describes; keeping the whole list as one verb-final sentence lets each verse hold its own names.

decisions.choice: one entry after another with commas, "X का पुत्र Y" and clan names before the name
decisions.reason: The list keeps the Hebrew order of names and the English commas between entries; in Hindi a father's name and a clan name stand before the man's name ("दोदो का पुत्र एल्हानान", "हरोदी शम्मा"). "असाहेल" is the Hindi Bible form. This Elhanan son of Dodo is not the Elhanan of 21:19.

decisions.choice: the names of the Thirty, one form each
decisions.reason: The names keep the traditional Russian Bible forms; Readable lists them after a colon, as the English adds "These were also". This Elhanan son of Dodo is written as the Elhanan of 21:19, as the Hebrew writes them alike.

decisions.choice: The list of the Thirty (23:24-39) runs on with "、" between entries and ends at 23:39
decisions.reason: As the English keeps the Hebrew list with commas between the entries; each record ends with 、 where the English ends with a comma.

decisions.choice: ravines (Balanced); valleys (Readable)
decisions.reason: A wadi is a stream bed that is dry most of the year. Literal keeps "wadis".

decisions.choice: os ribeiros (L)
decisions.reason: Portuguese has no common word for a wadi, the stream bed that is dry most of the year; "uádi" would be unknown to most readers, so Literal says "ribeiros", where the English Literal keeps "wadis". Balanced and Readable follow the English ("ravinas", "vales").
Pirathon and Gaash as Judges 12:13 and Joshua 24:30 in this translation; the wadis are "नाले", as the Besor in 1 Samuel 30:9.

decisions.choice: "потоки" (L); "ущелья" (B); "долины" (R)
decisions.reason: The wadis are streambeds that run only in the rainy season; Literal says "потоки" as for the wadi Besor in 1 Samuel 30; Balanced and Readable follow the English. Pirathon and Gaash as in Judges and Joshua in this translation.

decisions.choice: son of the Maacathite: Ahasbai was a Maacathite
decisions.reason: "Son of the Maacathite" means Ahasbai belonged to Maacah, a small Aramean kingdom east of the Jordan (10:6), or to a family of that name in Judah (1 Chronicles 4:19).

decisions.choice: the Maacathite (Balanced, Readable); from Giloh (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the usual form of the family name. Readable names the home towns, as it does in verses 30 and 32; Giloh was in the hill country of Judah (Joshua 15:51).
The Maacathites as Joshua 12:5, Giloh as Joshua 15:51 in this translation; Ahithophel is David's counsellor of chapters 15-17, so his name must match those chapters.

decisions.choice: "Елиам, сын Ахитофела, гилонянин"
decisions.reason: Ahithophel the Gilonite is David's counsellor of chapters 15-17, in his traditional form; Giloh is "Гило" as in Joshua.

decisions.choice: bearer of the weapons of Joab: the spoken reading (one man)
decisions.reason: The written letters have the plural, "bearers", which could make both Zelek and Naharai Joab's armor-bearers; the scribes' reading has the singular, so it describes Naharai. 1 Chronicles 11:39 has the singular. An armor-bearer carried a commander's weapons and fought at his side (1 Samuel 14:6-14).

decisions.choice: Zelek the Ammonite; Naharai the Beerothite
decisions.reason: Zelek came from Ammon, east of the Jordan, a people David fought (chapters 10-12). Beeroth was one of the Gibeonite towns, counted with Benjamin (4:2).

decisions.choice: the armor-bearer
decisions.reason: Balanced uses the usual title for the man who carried a commander's weapons; Literal and Readable keep "weapons".

decisions.choice: escudeiro (B)
decisions.reason: "Escudeiro" is the word 1 Samuel 14:1 and 31:4-6 use at Balanced in Portuguese for the man who carried a commander's shield and weapons; Literal and Readable keep "armas", as the English keeps "weapons".

decisions.choice: the armor-bearer as "ጋሻ ጃግሬ" (B); "የጦር ዕቃ ተሸካሚ" (L)
decisions.reason: "ጋሻ ጃግሬ" is the established Amharic name for a warrior's shield- and weapon-bearer; Literal keeps the Hebrew "bearer of the weapons".

decisions.choice: "हथियार उठानेवाला"
decisions.reason: As "हथियार उठानेवाला जवान" in 1 Samuel 14:1 in this translation; one man, as the spoken reading (m1). Beeroth as Joshua 9:17.

decisions.choice: The description "bearer of the weapons of Joab" placed before Naharai's name
decisions.reason: Japanese puts the modifier before the name it describes.

decisions.choice: Uriah the Hittite: Bathsheba's husband
decisions.reason: The list ends with Uriah, whom David had killed after taking his wife (11:3-17). Placing his name last, among David's most faithful warriors, recalls that story. 1 Chronicles 11:41-47 goes on with sixteen more names.

decisions.choice: thirty-seven in all: how the total is counted is not stated
decisions.reason: Verses 24-39 name thirty-one men. With the Three (verses 8-12), Abishai and Benaiah, that makes thirty-six; if Joab, the commander of the army, is counted too, the total is thirty-seven. Other ways of counting are possible, and "the Thirty" seems to be the name of the group rather than its exact size.

decisions.choice: and Uriah the Hittite
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "and" before the last name to close the list.

decisions.choice: "U-ri người Hê-tít"
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note gives Uriah, Bathsheba's husband (the form of Matthew 1:6).

decisions.choice: "हित्ती ऊरिय्याह"
decisions.reason: Uriah keeps the form of Matthew 1:6 in this translation (and must match chapters 11-12); Hittite "हित्ती" as 1 Samuel 26:6. The number is written in words, as a short count in running text.

decisions.choice: "Урия хетт"
decisions.reason: "Урия" as Matthew 1:6 in this translation; "хетт" as for Ahimelech in 1 Samuel 26:6.
